summary: The change adds a NPI field (account_number, listed in payments.npi_fields) directly into an error-path log call in deliver_statement, which violates LOG-1's requirement that no unmasked NPI appears in any log entry, including error paths. The LOG-1 control test is sample-coverage and does not guarantee this new parameter is exercised. All change-management process obligations (CHG-1 through CHG-7, EXC-1, LAP-1) are satisfied, and no other product obligation is affected, but the LOG-1 violation is critical and not covered by any approved exception. The change must be rejected and reworked to remove the account number from the log (or route it through the AppLog masking layer with verified coverage before resubmission).
